updates.tweet_text: Putting total blinders on took my trading to the next level. I pay 0 attention to what other traders say, macro, other charts. Only input to my decisions is 1) My ES chart 2) My 1 entry setup 3) My 1 trade management system. World doesn't exist outside that. All signal, no noise
updates.notes: Pure philosophy/methodology commentary. No prices, no actionable levels, no naming language whatsoever.
